explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Tag_Processor` to scan the input linearly and `next_tag( 'img' )` to match every IMG tag case-insensitively while skipping comments and text, then `add_class( 'wp-image' )` to append the class without disturbing existing class order or other bytes; `get_updated_html()` returns the original document with only the queued tag edits applied.
